text:
Priya: Heads up from BetaCorp demo. They want deterministic fallback to their on-prem private model when hosted model confidence < .6 + per-tenant quantized model placement. They called it a dealbreaker.
Ken: Oof. Competitor already has "migration adapter" that forwards to customer-hosted model for certain keys. Tech lift depends on how we surface policies.
Lena: Sales says BetaCorp needs guarantees: 99th percentile fallback <= 200ms and daily usage CSVs grouped by tenant+model. Also want immutable change history for policy edits.
Ivy: Two choices: build a native per-tenant model routing feature (big, months) or ship a compatibility adapter proxying traffic to customer endpoints for pilot. Adapter is lower risk.
Priya: Launch criteria for pilot: 1) adapter that can route by tenant + condition 2) metrics for fallback latency 3) CSV export with tenant, model, tokens 4) policy audit log. If pilot meets thresholds, BetaCorp will extend trial.
Ken: Native solution complexity: model sandboxing, quantization scheduling, secure key exchange. Rough: 3-4 sprints core infra + 2 for console policy UX. Adapter path: 2-week spike + 1 sprint for alpha.
Lena: BetaCorp will accept alpha adapter if we sign a migration roadmap: native per-tenant bundles by Q3. We should get that in writing.
Ivy: Proposal: ship "compat-adapter" for pilot + "per-tenant bundles" on roadmap. Use adapter to collect real traffic patterns and perf numbers to inform native design.
Priya: Positioning copy: "Enterprise migration adapter: keep your models, keep your SLAs". Turn parity ask into a migration story and competitive differentiator.
Ken: Quick sketch of policy API for adapter (alpha):
```json
POST /v1/policies/fallbacks
{
  "tenant_id": "beta-123",
  "match": { "confidence_lt": 0.6 },
  "fallback_endpoint": "https://onprem.beta.local/infer",
  "timeout_ms": 150,
  "audit_meta": { "created_by": "ken@redwood" }
}
```
Response includes policy_id and immutable audit_id.
Lena: I'll draft the BetaCorp pilot letter with explicit scope and timeline (adapter in 3w, CSVs daily, metric dashboard). Legal wants retention windows for audit logs.
Ivy: We'll need secure transport (mTLS) and token exchange flow for adapter. Spike should verify perf and security.
Priya: Owners and dates: Spike (Ken) - 10d, Adapter alpha (Ivy) - 1 sprint, CSV/export hook (Priya) - 1 sprint, Pilot comms & contract (Lena) - 5d, Console policy UX (Ken) - backlog Q3.
ci-bot: staging deployment created: staging/compat-adapter-alpha (deployed by Ken) - https://staging.internal/compat-adapter :rocket:
Ken: I'll start the spike and post perf numbers here. If the adapter exceeds 200ms p99 we need to consider sticky local cache or prefetching.
Lena: Good. Sales ask: can we show a live demo in 3 weeks? If spike looks good we commit to that date in pilot letter.
Ivy: Also consider telemetry: tag fallback events with reason code (timeout, low_confidence, explicit rule) so product can prioritize native features.
Priya: Agreed. Let's aim for demo in 3w. I'll book triage sync next Tue 10am to lock scope and decks. :calendar:
